# @astilba/cache

A portable TypeScript caching library — tag invalidation (soft/hard), classified stale-if-error resilience, and private-by-default scopes. Targets Node, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers.

> 🚧 **Under construction — not yet released.** Built spec-first: the full public API and a suite of correctness invariants were pinned *before* implementation, so every behavior is anchored by a test that must stay green. The correctness kernel is complete; real Cloudflare Workers drivers are in progress.
